title: Kurapika Turns the Ambush Around Part 1

cuts.voiceover_text: The gunmen think Kurapika is trapped—until his hand moves. An ambush is underway. Gunmen surround the street and fire toward the car as headlights and muzzle flashes tear through the night. The bodyguards scatter, but Kurapika turns toward the attackers instead of backing away. One gunman raises his weapon at point-blank range. Kurapika lifts his hand. A glowing chain lashes across the frame, and the attacker's confidence disappears. More men rush in with rifles. They expect an easy target. They get a counterattack. Blue lines snap through the darkness and lock the group in place. The gunmen stumble, drop their weapons, and realize the trap has reversed. Kurapika moves through the smoke as the ambush collapses around him. The hunters are now surrounded. When the light fades, the attackers are pinned, and Kurapika is still standing.

But the scene does not end with the attackers down. The camera leaves the wreckage and climbs past the city lights. A familiar figure waits above the streets. Hisoka stands on the rooftop, relaxed and amused. The shot cuts closer. His smile sharpens. Then one bloodshot eye fills the screen. Kurapika survived the ambush, but Hisoka was watching from above. What has he been waiting for?

series.summary: Kurapika turns a nighttime ambush against its attackers, while Hisoka appears above the city with an unknown plan.
